meta.name: track-management
meta.description: Use this skill when creating, managing, or working with Conductor tracks - the logical work units for features, bugs, and refactors. Applies to spec.md, plan.md, and track lifecycle operations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理功能、缺陷和重构的开发工作单元与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果开发时需要把功能、缺陷和重构整理成有文档的工作单元
copy.tagline_en: Organize features, bugs, and refactors into trackable work units
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break dev work into tracked units with specs and plans

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Conductor track 的规范帮你创建和维护工作单元(功能、bug、重构),写出 spec.md 和 plan.md,并维护 tracks.md 注册表、状态标记和提交 SHA 记录。
howto.when: 当你要新建功能、bug 或重构的 track,或撰写、审阅 spec.md、plan.md,以及管理 track 从创建到完成的生命周期时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我新建一个功能 track,并写出它的 spec.md
say.note: 会套用 track 模板生成规格文件

say.text: 把当前 track 的任务标记为完成,并记下 commit SHA
say.note: 会更新状态标记和 SHA 记录

say.text: 把这个 plan.md 拆成每阶段 3-5 个任务
say.note: 会拆成小阶段并补上验证任务

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude creates and maintains Conductor tracks — the work units for features, bugs, and refactors. It writes spec.md and plan.md, keeps the tracks.md registry, and updates status markers and commit SHAs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you create or manage a track, write or review spec.md or plan.md, or handle track lifecycle and the tracks.md registry.

say_en.text: Create a new feature track and write its spec.md
say_en.note: Generates the spec file from the track template

say_en.text: Mark this track's tasks done and record the commit SHA
say_en.note: Updates status markers and SHA notes

say_en.text: Split this plan.md into phases of 3-5 tasks
say_en.note: Breaks work into small phases with verification tasks
